lines.before: The project's own filled "Rules every brief carries" block (rule:agent-team-adapter) adds the project's values and wins where it differs from the preloaded rules. Guards back the table: the builder's edit fence and the checker's clean-tree stop run as hooks in the role files, and the push guard also runs as a git pre-push hook (once `core.hooksPath` points at `.githooks`), so it holds for any AI tool that marks its shell.
